verdict.rationale: Mem0's docs describe an advanced-retrieval feature with reranking that reorders results to put the most relevant memories first. The search docs also advertise "semantic and filtered search capabilities", and entity scoping by user, agent, app and session narrows retrieval. Together these let a developer steer recall beyond a single fixed similarity search. missing for 10: any evidence of keyword/hybrid search modes, concrete detail on metadata filter syntax and operators, independent or hands-on corroboration of reranking and filter quality.
